newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 1997/98 budget requests seen up 8.4 pct - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan 1997/98 budget requests seen up 8.4 pct - MOF.

text.p: Budget requests from Japan's ministries and state agencies for next fiscal year are likely to be about 8.4 percent higher than this year's original allocations, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Monday.

Requests for the year starting April 1, 1997, are projected to total 81.44 trillion yen, up from 75.10 trillion yen a year earlier. Budget requests for the current year grew 11.6 percent from the approved 1995/96 budget.
A senior MOF official told reporters that the ministry wanted to suppress the growth in budget requests in light of tight state finances.
